scores.notes: Pocket-watch dials on the table (right) and in the grass (bottom right) carry numeral-like marks; top-right corner fades to bare cream paper (accepted). Otherwise a sound tea-party scene; the Dormouse has rabbit-like long ears.

Card soldiers and card hoops show corner indices (letters/numerals); the Queen's heart-tipped sceptre, stiff upturned white collar and heart-paneled yellow skirt echo the Disney Queen of Hearts design. Top-right fades to pale paper (accepted).

Pinned papers on the wall above the mantel (upper left) bear lines of pseudo-script and mantel clock dials carry marks; otherwise Holmes holds the blue stone to the bay-window light with Watson seated right as asked.
Tabernacle courtyard centred with the cloud above it and tents radiating outward; left and right edges and top-left corner vignette into white paper (accepted). No lettering found.

A second Alice look-alike (fair-haired girl in blue dress and white pinafore) stands in the bottom-left crowd; the guards at the rear door are humans in card-printed tabards rather than flat oblong cards, and the crowd is mostly grotesque humans rather than animals.
Board on the corner house reads 'PAWNBROKER' with a faint second line, and a painted signature/date sits in the bottom-left corner; scene itself (Holmes, Watson, gilt balls, railed plot) is shown.
The father runs toward the viewer with arms open while the son walks behind him in the same direction, so the father is running away from the son rather than toward him; no lettering or edge issues.
Faint glyph-like strokes are painted on the glowing wall just above the spectral hand (centre top); Daniel raises a refusing hand toward the seated Belshazzar as asked.
A row of glowing pseudo-script characters beside the hand is written on the blue brick wall (centre); otherwise Daniel faces the enthroned Belshazzar among feasting nobles.
David with emptied sling, Goliath pitching forward in a burst of dust, armies on both flanks; the top sky and upper corners are bare white paper (accepted). No lettering found.
David's sling pouch still holds a stone (upper centre-left) even though the stone has already struck Goliath and lies by his helmet, a contradictory moment; Goliath falls face-first as asked.

Bald Elisha walks the road while youths stream from the Bethel gate pointing and jeering, villagers watch from doorways, golden calf shrine on the rise; Elisha faces downhill toward the viewer but the moment reads. No lettering.
Alice has three striped legs with three black shoes (bottom centre), one extending toward the Mock Turtle's foot; Gryphon and turtle flank her on a shingle beach.
Row of carved stone markers recedes down a limestone village street, largest at left foreground, villagers passing and a Roman soldier by the wall at right; stone carvings are reliefs without glyphs.
Rephaiah on scaffold at centre-left points as workers heave a block into the wall, basket-carriers and armoured overseers around; hands and limbs look sound, no lettering.
Moses sits on the rock holding a staff at chest height with arms lowered; Aaron and Hur stand beside him holding their own staffs instead of holding up his arms, so the central action is not shown.

Folded newspaper on the right-hand desk shows a pseudo-letter masthead and text columns (scene asked for no visible writing), with text-like papers on the floor; Wilson is in a wrestler's crouch rather than half-risen from a chair.

The mantel clock face (right) shows numerals and the paper on the floor at bottom left bears glyph marks; edges and top-right corner are white paper (accepted). Holmes at the window with the brougham visible, Watson rising by the fire.
Father runs toward the son with arms wide while the son halts and lifts a hand, villagers in a doorway at left; the top-right sky fades to bare paper (accepted).

Villagers on the hillside face the evening sky, one lifting a hand, lit village at left and walled town by the shore, a red-cloaked soldier far down the road; left edge vignettes to white paper (accepted).

Old man laid on a woven mat with hands folded, a woman kneeling at his head and family grouped around, viewed from the tent mouth with well, fields and settlement behind; his eyes look half-open, but nothing clearly faulty.
Viewed down into the pit: Daniel unharmed centre with calm lions, Darius kneeling at the rim reaching down, attendants with rope and lamp, lid raised; right edge fades to white paper (accepted).
Golden radiance breaks through black cloud over dark waters with no figure, face or human shape in the light; edges fully painted, no lettering.

Both seraphim show bare feet below their robes (wings do not cover the feet) and the left one covers its face with its hands, so the visionary creatures do not follow the text; the right seraph already holds the tongs and coal of a later verse. No figure stands for God.
Daniel stands centred among crouching, closed-mouthed lions beside a glowing angel, Darius with torch leans over the barred gate above; no lettering or anatomy problems seen.
Crates at left, behind Merryweather and at right are stencilled with pseudo-letter text; Holmes kneels with lens and lantern and Merryweather sits sulking on a crate as asked.
